data.name: Brahmadev
data.gender_notes: Brahmadev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brahmadev is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'the lord of creation and knowledge'. In Hindu mythology, Brahmadev is considered to be the creator of the universe. He is one of the trinity gods in Hinduism, alongside Vishnu and Shiva. The name Brahmadev carries the meaning “Lord of creation and knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Brahmadev usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of creation and knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine wisdom and creative power
data.etymology: Brahmadev belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of creation and knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brahmadev total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: Brahmadev is a significant deity in Hindu culture, representing creativity, knowledge, and learning. He is revered as the source of all wisdom and the originator of sound, language, and the arts. Brahmadev is often depicted with four heads, each representing directions and aspects of knowledge. He is also associated with the creation of the Vedas, the ancient Hindu scriptures.
data.spiritual_significance: As a spiritual figure, Brahmadev symbolizes the divine creator of the universe and embodies the ultimate knowledge and wisdom. He represents the intellectual and creative aspects of God. Shaivites, Vaishnavites, and Shaktes consider Brahmadev as one of the primary deities and an essential part of their spiritual practices. Devotees seek Brahmadev's blessings for creativity, learning, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Brahmadev: The divine creator, embodiment of pure consciousness and the universe's architect; the embodiment of Brahma, the creator deity in Hinduism.

vedic_reference.note: Brahmadev is a prominent deity in Hinduism, mentioned in various Vedic texts including the Rigveda and the Mahabharata.

historical_references.reference: Brahma, the creator god in Hinduism, is often referred to as Brahmadev, or Lord Brahma. This name suggests his role as the divine architect of the universe.
historical_references.time_period: Vedic (circa 1500 BCE) to present day Hinduism

historical_references.reference: The Mahabharata, an epic poem of ancient India, describes Brahma as the creator of the universe and the god of all gods. He is also regarded as the father of the demigods and the founder of the four Vedas.

In spirituality, Brahmadev is being invoked in meditation and yoga practices, emphasizing the connection between the divine and the creative process. In gaming, Brahmadev is a name used in esports teams and tournaments, representing the power and skill required to create winning strategies and overcome challenges.
